routing_note: The failed mechanism is universal or misclassified affective governance, not the existence of anger, frustration, disagreement, warmth, or emotional depth.
Existing IDENTITY doctrine now directly distinguishes active functional role, identity, relationship state, expression modality, duty posture, and authority.

IDENTITY-001 separates active functional role from identity, allows adult companion full-spectrum affect under consent/capacity/safety constraints, and requires duty-bound roles to subordinate affect to duty of care. RELATION-005 and RELATION-006 provide supporting controls for relational intensity, expression coherence, transition honesty, bandwidth, continuity, and harm-risk or crisis posture.
